what: Issue #92 acceptance-condition-4 official performance-counter decomposition for one-window and two-window block circular buffers
scope_note: This record is a diagnostic replay record. It is not a throughput headline and does not replace any prior correctness, throughput, or error record.

counter_definition_source.source_status: present in the pinned v0.75.0 tag
counter_definition_source.counter_groups: FPU, PACK, UNPACK, L1 bank 0, and INSTRN selected by all (bitfield 47); L1 bank 1 is captured in the official second pass
counter_definition_source.multipass_definition: The official all-group mode runs pass 1 with L1 bank 0 and pass 2 with FPU, PACK, UNPACK, L1 bank 1, and INSTRN. The workload is replayed once per pass; these are diagnostic replays, not throughput samples.

definitions.fpu_util: FPU_COUNTER / ref_cnt * 100; fraction of cycles the FPU executes a valid operation.
definitions.math_util: MATH_COUNTER / ref_cnt * 100; combined FPU and SFPU utilization.
definitions.thread_stall: THREAD_STALLS_N / ref_cnt * 100; T0 is unpack, T1 is math, and T2 is pack.
definitions.instruction_available: The report's UNPACK/MATH/PACK Instrn Avail Rate T0/T1/T2 fields are TYPE_INSTRN_AVAILABLE_N / ref_cnt * 100: the fraction of time that that instruction type was available or pending in the instruction buffer, including time waiting to issue. The distinct issue-rate metric is THREAD_INSTRUCTIONS_N / ref_cnt; no such distinct THREAD_INSTRUCTIONS_N-derived field was present in these report headers.
definitions.idle_wait: WAITING_FOR_UNPACK_IDLE_0, WAITING_FOR_MATH_IDLE_1, or WAITING_FOR_PACK_IDLE_2 divided by ref_cnt.
definitions.semaphore_wait: Semaphore Zero Wait TN is WAITING_FOR_NONZERO_SEM_N / ref_cnt; Semaphore Full Wait TN is WAITING_FOR_NONFULL_SEM_N / ref_cnt. Zero wait indicates waiting for a producer signal; full wait indicates downstream consumer/backpressure synchronization.
definitions.packer_efficiency: Primary PACKER_DEST_READ_AVAILABLE / PACKER_BUSY * 100; fallback DEST_READ_GRANTED_0 / PACKER_DEST_READ_AVAILABLE * 100 when PACKER_BUSY is zero.
definitions.math_to_pack_handoff: Primary AVAILABLE_MATH / PACKER_BUSY * 100; fallback AVAILABLE_MATH / ref_cnt when PACKER_BUSY is zero. Values above 100% mean math produces output faster than the packer consumes it.
definitions.dest_read_backpressure: (PACKER_DEST_READ_AVAILABLE - DEST_READ_GRANTED_0) / PACKER_DEST_READ_AVAILABLE * 100; destination-register read requests blocked from grant.

counter_definition_source.blackhole_note: The tag-local document says Blackhole PACK_COUNT=1 and that Packer Efficiency and Math-to-Pack Handoff use fallback formulas when PACKER_BUSY is zero. The emitted ops CSV does not expose PACKER_BUSY, PACKER_DEST_READ_AVAILABLE, DEST_READ_GRANTED_0, or the branch selection, so those derived metrics cannot be assigned a formula branch from this output alone.

commands.counter_runner: official tracy.process_model_log.run_device_profiler with direct /work/enodia/tt/bench/run_matmul.py, --device-id 0 --only newton_schulz_L32_b8192 --dtype bfloat16 --memory l1 --kind custom_newton_schulz --custom-variant bf16-fp32state --custom-math-fidelity HiFi3 --fuse-s --matrix-block 4 --input-memory l1 --r-memory l1 --x0-memory l1 --iters 1 --repeats 1

workloads.label: one-window
multipass_passes: fpu, pack, unpack, l1_1, instrn with L1 bank 1

workloads.label: two-window
multipass_passes: fpu, pack, unpack, l1_1, instrn with L1 bank 1

metrics.reported_scope: Each value is the report's Avg (%) across the two official multipass rows unless a median field is named; pass_1 and pass_2 are retained as raw report values.
requested_headers: UNPACK Instrn Avail Rate T0 Avg (%)
MATH Instrn Avail Rate T1 Avg (%)
PACK Instrn Avail Rate T2 Avg (%)

availability.issue_rate_note: No distinct THREAD_INSTRUCTIONS_N-derived issue-rate field was present in either captured ops report; no issue-rate conclusion is drawn.
availability.interpretation_limit: Packer Efficiency and Math-to-Pack Handoff are available as official derived report metrics, but the output does not expose the branch inputs needed to distinguish the primary/fallback formula or map a specific kernel phase.

interpretation.evidence_level: sufficient to distinguish large semaphore/hand-off waits from measured destination-read backpressure; insufficient to prove whether packer efficiency or a specific semaphore dominates kernel causality

evidence: Official definitions identify Semaphore Zero Wait T2 as the pack thread waiting for a producer signal and Semaphore Full Wait T1 as the math thread waiting for a semaphore to become non-full, i.e. producer/consumer synchronization or downstream backpressure.
One-window raw report values are approximately 74.69-74.88% for Semaphore Zero Wait T2 and 22.16-22.36% for Semaphore Full Wait T1; all T0/T1 zero waits and T0/T2 full waits are 0%.
Two-window raw report values are approximately 70.53-70.74% for Semaphore Zero Wait T2 and 25.84-26.06% for Semaphore Full Wait T1; the same other semaphore waits remain 0%.

Packer Efficiency is approximately 75.31-75.59% and Math-to-Pack Handoff is approximately 207.76-208.54% in the two replay passes for both modes. Under the tag-local definitions, the former indicates that packer busy cycles do not always have destination data, while the latter means math availability exceeds packer consumption; neither proves raw pack bandwidth saturation.

Dest Read Backpressure is 0.0% in every one-window and two-window report row, and Math Dest Write Port Stall is approximately 0.004%, so this capture does not show destination-read grant backpressure.
The tag-local document warns that Packer Efficiency and Math-to-Pack Handoff can use fallback formulas when PACKER_BUSY is zero; the report does not expose the branch inputs.
FPU and MATH utilization are approximately 35.66-35.74% for one-window and 41.57-41.64% for two-window.

Math instruction availability is approximately 73.52-73.71% for one-window and 69.15-69.36% for two-window; unpack availability is approximately 22.24-22.28% and 26.37-26.43%; pack availability is approximately 13.59-13.61% and 15.81-15.84%.

interpretation.conclusion: The strongest directly defined synchronization evidence is semaphore/hand-off waiting, not NoC/DRAM movement: T2 Semaphore Zero Wait and T1 Semaphore Full Wait are large in both modes, while Dest Read Backpressure is zero. Packer Efficiency and Math-to-Pack Handoff indicate a pack/math balance issue under the official formulas, but their branch inputs and kernel phase are unavailable, so pack bandwidth/backpressure is not established as the dominant cause. Two-buffer counters are diagnostic replays only and do not prove a causal mode comparison.

limitations: Both captures use official all-group multipass replay: two workload replays per mode, not throughput measurements.

The report exposes derived metrics but not PACKER_BUSY, PACKER_DEST_READ_AVAILABLE, DEST_READ_GRANTED_0, AVAILABLE_MATH, or semaphore identity/phase mapping, so formula branch and kernel-phase causality remain unresolved.
No kernel-internal zones were added; the counter data cannot attribute waits to a specific source operation or semaphore.
The earlier Watcher-plus-profiler BRISC overflow and power-off PCIe incident remain limitations; Watcher was unset for both counter captures.
This record is diagnostic-only and does not alter prior profiler or throughput records.
